title: "We Have to Assume That the Internet Will Go Offline in the Next Few Years"
summary: Former Stability AI CEO Emad Mostaque predicts that AI systems will become so sophisticated they may eventually replace traditional internet access, suggesting we should prepare for scenarios where current internet infrastructure becomes obsolete. The article discusses his views on AI development trajectories and the potential transformation of how humans interact with information.
problem_solved: Provides forward-looking perspective on potential major shifts in internet infrastructure and information access patterns driven by AI advancement
why_valuable: Offers insights from an influential AI industry leader about possible disruptive scenarios that could reshape technology infrastructure in coming years
